script: He faked paralysis for years, until one moment exposed him completely. For over a decade, a man collected disability payments, claiming he could not walk without a wheelchair. Doctors examined him. Insurance investigators watched him. He never slipped, not once. Then investigators secretly filmed him outside his own house, mowing his lawn, standing on both feet. The footage went straight to court. He tried to explain it away, but the video did not lie. The payments stopped, and the case became one of the most cited fraud examples on record. Years of pretending, undone in a single afternoon on his own front lawn. He faked paralysis for years, and one afternoon exposed him completely.
